recommend.ai_reasoning: For a balanced risk appetite I'm splitting capital 60/40 between ETH/USDC (27.5% APY) and STRK/USDC (26.5% APY) on Ekubo. This gives you exposure to the two deepest Starknet pairs while keeping portfolio-level impermanent-loss risk manageable. The split was verified by the YieldOptimality circuit — the blended yield of 27.1% is within 200 bps of the single-best-pool yield, so you gain diversification without a meaningful yield drag. StrategyIntegrity confirms no single position exceeds the maximum weight threshold, and effective leverage stays at 1x.
recommend.portfolio_risk_assessment: This balanced allocation balances your risk tolerance with yield optimization.

bridge_unlocks.design_signal: ModelBridge binds model_output + proof/model hashes + bounds + timestamp into a Groth16 public-signal commitment that policy lanes can enforce.
bridge_unlocks.unlock: Model output -> policy gate, not just model output -> score
bridge_unlocks.why_it_matters: Lets AI recommendations become cryptographically gateable execution intents.

bridge_unlocks.design_signal: Bridge lane can consume zkML-style artifacts, format calldata for Garaga, then target Starknet verification paths.
bridge_unlocks.why_it_matters: De-risks lock-in to a single proving stack while keeping one policy interface.

bridge_unlocks.design_signal: The same intent can flow through SNARK (Groth16/Garaga) and STARK (integrity/SNOS-style) lanes with mirror status tracking.
bridge_unlocks.why_it_matters: Allows product-level trust modes instead of one hardcoded proof lane.

bridge_unlocks.design_signal: Bridge proofs feed strategy gating while shielded/nullifier/relayer rails preserve user privacy and selective disclosure.
bridge_unlocks.why_it_matters: Supports private capital ops without losing verifiable safety checks.

forecaster_showcase.explain_narration: The model predicted returns of 0.65% for 5 minutes, 1.05% for 30 minutes, and 1.60% for 4 hours, with probabilities of price increases at 61.1%, 69.4%, and 78.8%, respectively. After scoring, the actual returns were higher at 0.90% for 5 minutes, 1.80% for 30 minutes, and 3.90% for 4 hours, achieving perfect directional accuracy. Keep in mind that while the model was accurate, actual market conditions can vary significantly, so use predictions as one of many tools in your decision-making.

highlights: Scored metrics: directional 100.0%, MAE 1.10% (110.0 bps), Brier 0.0967, ECE 0.3025
